items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares ten advances on long-open math and CS problems solved by internal Astra model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布內部 Astra 模型解決的十項長期開放數學與資科問題進展
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 OpenAI published results from an internal version of its next major model Astra on ten problems that had seen no main-result progress for at least a decade (many far longer). The results cover high-dimensional sphere packing, non-sofic groups, a disproof of Connes’s rigidity conjecture, permanent circuit lower bounds, quantum parallel repetition, lattice CVP hardness, Ehrhart volume, multicolor Ramsey numbers and extremal graph theory. Lean 4 formalizations, reasoning narrations and a manuscript were released; total inference cost was estimated at roughly $2,000 at Sol API rates.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日 OpenAI 公布其下一世代主要模型 Astra 內部版本，在十個至少十年無主要進展的數學與理論資科問題上取得新結果。涵蓋高維球堆積、非 sofic 群存在性、Connes 剛性猜想反證、permanent 電路下界、量子平行重複、格 CVP 硬度、Ehrhart 體積、多色 Ramsey 數與極值圖論等。已釋出 Lean 4 形式化證明、推理敘述與手稿；估計總推理成本約 2,000 美元（以 Sol API 計價）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the clearest public demonstrations yet that frontier models can generate novel, formalizable results on hard open problems at modest cost. It elevates questions of attribution, peer verification and how mathematical communities will integrate AI-generated arguments; whether the results survive independent scrutiny and whether Astra itself ships soon remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前最清晰的公開案例之一，顯示前沿模型能以低成本產生可形式化的新數學結果。它提升了歸屬權、同儕驗證與數學社群如何接納 AI 生成論證的議題；結果能否通過獨立審查，以及 Astra 本身何時公開，仍屬未知。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are sharing a selection of ten results to problems that have been open and have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade, and in most cases much longer.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享十項結果，針對至少十年（多數情況更久）主結果無進展的開放問題。

items_flat.title_en: Minnesota AI nudification ban takes effect after judge denies xAI TRO
items_flat.title_zh: 明尼蘇達州 AI 裸化禁令生效，法官駁回 xAI 臨時禁制令
items_flat.summary_en: Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation law (HF 1606) banning AI tools that generate non-consensual intimate imagery of real people took effect on 1 August 2026 after U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank denied xAI’s request for a temporary restraining order on 31 July. The statute carries civil penalties up to $500,000 per violation; a preliminary-injunction hearing is set for 19 August. xAI had sued arguing the law is an overbroad, content-based restriction on protected speech.
items_flat.summary_zh: 明尼蘇達州全美首例禁止 AI 生成真實人物非自願親密影像的法律（HF 1606）於 2026 年 8 月 1 日生效。美國地區法官 Donovan Frank 於 7 月 31 日駁回 xAI 的臨時禁制令申請。該法每項違規最高可處 50 萬美元民事罰鍰；初步禁制令聽證會訂於 8 月 19 日。xAI 起訴主張該法過度寬泛、屬內容基礎的言論限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an early concrete test of state-level regulation of generative image models. It raises practical compliance questions for national platforms and leaves open whether the law survives First Amendment challenges on the merits.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是州層級監管生成式影像模型的早期具體測試。它對全國性平台提出實際合規問題，並留下該法是否能在第一修正案實質審查中存活的不確定性。
items_flat.quote: X.AI filed the motion on July 29, 2026, nearly three months after the law was signed, and only three days before the law is set to take effect. Such a delay in bringing the action and the motion suggests that harm is not immediate.
items_flat.quote_zh: X.AI 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日提出動議，距離法律簽署近三個月，且僅在法律生效前三天。如此延遲顯示損害並非立即發生。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk claims Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 on speed and cost
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 宣稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上為 Pareto 第一
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 Elon Musk posted that “Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost,” quoting independent testing that ranked it the best frontier model under those constraints. The claim accompanies ongoing public promotion of Grok 4.5.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日 Elon Musk 發文稱「Grok 4.5 在考慮速度與成本時為 Pareto 第一」，並引用獨立測試將其評為該約束下最佳前沿模型。此聲明伴隨 Grok 4.5 的持續公開推廣。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public Pareto claims keep competitive pressure on pricing and latency benchmarks, but independent third-party verification of the exact trade-off surface remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開的 Pareto 主張持續對定價與延遲基準施加競爭壓力，但對精確權衡曲面的獨立第三方驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.5 在考慮速度與成本時為 Pareto 第一

brief_en: OpenAI claims an internal Astra model solved 10 decade-plus open problems in math and theoretical CS (with Lean proofs); Minnesota’s AI nudification ban took effect after a judge denied xAI’s TRO; Elon Musk touted Grok 4.5 as Pareto-optimal on speed and cost. Quiet day otherwise across frontier labs.
brief_zh: OpenAI 宣布內部 Astra 模型解決 10 個逾十年未解數學與理論資科問題（含 Lean 證明）；明尼蘇達州 AI 裸化禁令在法官駁回 xAI 臨時禁制令後生效；馬斯克稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上 Pareto 最優。其餘大廠今日平靜。
